exclusion_reason: The PyPI 'truthscore' package is a reimplementation of RAGAS FactualCorrectness: it uses an LLM for claim decomposition (not LLM-free) and depends on ragas, so it is redundant with and not statistically independent of the RAGAS faithfulness baseline already reported. Genuinely LLM-free NLI faithfulness scorers (AlignScore, MiniCheck) have no PyPI distribution and were out of scope.

alternates_checked.trulens-eval: exists but is an LLM-judge eval framework, not a single LLM-free faithfulness metric
